_comment: Blocks so potent that only the finest ink can hold them (design 7.1.1: 'a small ink cannot hold a
mighty one'). This is also the always-on brake on treasure Ages -- a sea of diamonds costs a sea of
the rarest ink. Other mods extend this with their own materials by adding to the tag.
Entries are optional-safe: a block from a mod that is not installed is simply skipped.
The mod's own stones are here rather than in `forbidden` (2026-09-06): deretheni and temperstone are
writable, and what stops an Age made of one being free treasure is that it costs the rarest ink there
is. Same brake as a sea of diamonds, and it keeps the vocabulary honest -- a writer who has seen the
